situations.title: 수술 절차 간단 설명
situations.tagline: Can you walk me through what's actually going to happen once I go back there?
situations.brief: 수술 전 환자에게 예상 과정을 쉬운 말로 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me walk you through what happens step by step.
First we'll take you back, then the anesthesia team will get you comfortable.
You'll wake up in the recovery room when it's all done.

situations.title: 대기 시간 안내
situations.tagline: Do you have any idea how much longer I'll be waiting before they take me in?
situations.brief: 환자에게 예상 대기 시간을 현실적으로 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: The team is finishing the case before yours right now.
It should be about another thirty minutes or so.
I'll come right back and update you if anything changes.

situations.title: 불안 감정 경청
situations.tagline: I just... I can't stop thinking about everything that could go wrong today.
situations.brief: 환자의 불안한 감정을 판단 없이 반영하며 경청하세요.
keyPhrases: It sounds like a lot is on your mind right now.
Those feelings are completely understandable before surgery.
I'm right here, and you can tell me whatever you're feeling.

situations.title: 심호흡 이완 유도
situations.tagline: My heart is racing — is there anything I can do to calm myself down right now?
situations.brief: 환자에게 이완 호흡을 함께 안내해 긴장을 낮추세요.
keyPhrases: Let's take a slow breath in together through your nose.
Now breathe out gently, like you're blowing out a candle.
You're doing great — let's do that a few more times.

situations.title: 가족 면회 안내
situations.tagline: Will my husband be able to stay with me until they take me back?
situations.brief: 환자에게 가족 면회와 대기 안내를 명확히 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Your husband can stay with you right up until we head to the OR.
He'll wait in the family lounge and we'll update him during surgery.
As soon as you're in recovery, we'll bring him to see you.

situations.title: 회복 과정 설명
situations.tagline: After the surgery's over, what happens to me — where do I wake up?
situations.brief: 환자에게 수술 후 회복 흐름을 순서대로 안내하세요.
keyPhrases: You'll wake up in the recovery room, or PACU, right after surgery.
A nurse will be watching you closely as the anesthesia wears off.
Once you're stable and awake, we'll move you to your room.
goals: 수술 후 회복 단계를 순서대로 설명한다

situations.title: 통증 두려움 호소
situations.tagline: I'm terrified of the pain afterward — I have such a low tolerance for it.
situations.brief: 수술 후 통증 관리 계획을 구체적으로 설명해 두려움을 낮추세요.
keyPhrases: We have a clear plan to keep your pain under control.
You'll be able to tell us your pain level, and we'll adjust the medication.
The goal is to keep you comfortable enough to rest and heal.

situations.title: 마취 각성 못할까 두려움
situations.tagline: What if I go under and I just... don't wake up again?
situations.brief: 마취의 안전성을 구체적으로 설명해 각성 두려움을 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: The anesthesia team monitors you every second you're asleep.
Modern anesthesia is very safe and carefully controlled.
Waking up smoothly is exactly what they're trained to ensure.

situations.title: 이전 나쁜 수술 경험
situations.tagline: Last time I had surgery, I woke up in so much pain and no one listened to me.
situations.brief: 과거의 부정적 수술 경험을 반영하며 이번에는 다르게 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: That sounds like a really frightening experience last time.
Thank you for telling me — it helps us take better care of you.
We'll listen to you closely and stay ahead of your pain this time.

situations.title: 종교·문화적 요구
situations.tagline: Before surgery, I need a moment to pray — is that something you can allow?
situations.brief: 환자의 종교적 문화적 요구를 존중하며 배려하세요.
keyPhrases: Of course — please take the time you need to pray.
Is there anything I can do to make that easier for you?
We want to respect what's important to you today.

situations.title: 정보 과다 요구 환자
situations.tagline: I've read everything online and I need to know every single detail before I agree to this.
situations.brief: 정보를 과하게 요구하는 환자에게 수준을 조절하며 응대하세요.
keyPhrases: I can tell you've done a lot of research — that's good.
Let me focus on what matters most for you today.
Your surgeon can answer the more detailed medical questions.

situations.title: 침묵·회피 불안 환자
situations.tagline: I'm fine. I don't really want to talk about it.
situations.brief: 말이 없고 회피하는 환자의 비언어적 불안을 알아차리세요.
keyPhrases: You seem a little quiet — that's okay.
I noticed your hands are shaking a bit.
I'm here whenever you feel like talking.

situations.title: 소아 놀이 통한 안심
situations.tagline: Is the sleepy air going to hurt? I don't want a shot.
situations.brief: 소아 환자에게 발달 단계에 맞춰 놀이로 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: The sleepy air smells a little funny, but it doesn't hurt at all.
You can hold your teddy bear the whole time.
Let's pretend we're blowing up a big balloon together.

situations.title: 통역 통한 불안 완화
situations.tagline: I don't understand much English — I'm scared and I need someone to explain.
situations.brief: 통역을 통해 언어 장벽이 있는 환자를 정서적으로 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm going to bring an interpreter so we understand each other clearly.
Please take your time — we're in no rush.
I want to make sure you feel safe and informed.

situations.title: 수술 취소 걱정 안심
situations.tagline: They keep delaying — are they going to cancel my surgery after I fasted all night?
situations.brief: 지연 사유를 설명하며 수술 취소 걱정을 안심시키세요.
keyPhrases: Your surgery isn't cancelled — the schedule just shifted a bit.
The delay is because the previous case ran longer than expected.
I'll keep you updated the moment we have a time.

situations.title: 극심한 공황 발작
situations.tagline: I can't breathe — I have to get out of here, I can't do this!
situations.brief: 급성 불안 발작을 보이는 환자를 침착하게 진정시키세요.
keyPhrases: I'm right here with you — you're safe.
Let's breathe together slowly, in and out.
Focus on my voice — this feeling will pass.

situations.title: 수술 직전 거부 의사
situations.tagline: I've changed my mind — I don't want to go through with this surgery.
situations.brief: 수술 거부 의사를 존중하며 경청하고 팀에 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: It's your right to change your mind, and I'll respect that.
Can you help me understand what's making you hesitate?
I'll let your surgeon know so we can talk it through together.

situations.title: 자해 위험 표현
situations.tagline: Honestly, part of me hopes I just don't make it off that table.
situations.brief: 자해 위험을 시사하는 표현을 즉시 인지하고 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm really glad you told me how you're feeling.
I want to make sure you have the support you need right now.
I'm going to stay with you and bring in someone who can help.

situations.title: 과호흡 진정 요구
situations.tagline: My hands are tingling and I can't slow my breathing down — help me!
situations.brief: 과호흡을 보이는 환자를 진정시키고 호흡을 중재하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm here — let's slow this down together.
Breathe in with me for four, and out for four.
The tingling will ease as your breathing settles.

situations.title: 유도 중 극도 저항
situations.tagline: No — take it off, I don't want the mask on my face!
situations.brief: 마취 유도 중 극도로 저항하는 환자를 안정시키세요.
keyPhrases: I've got you — you're safe, just look at me.
The mask is only oxygen to help you rest.
Take slow breaths, we're right here with you.

situations.title: 나쁜 예후 인지 절망
situations.tagline: The doctor told me this might be the last time I'm awake — what's even the point?
situations.brief: 나쁜 예후를 인지한 환자의 절망을 지지하고 연계하세요.
keyPhrases: I can hear how much pain you're carrying right now.
You don't have to face this alone.
I'd like to bring in our chaplain and support team to be with you.
